name: Muskegon County, MI
findings: Muskegon County has 549 nonprofit organizations. 242 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 179 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Muskegon County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 43 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 43 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Youth organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 11 youth organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 5 in similar places of this size.
